issues.note: Oil/water/gas entered in m3 (x0.159) instead of stb/bbl/Mscf-equivalent; rate looks like a ~84% drop with no change in choke/WHP.
Six consecutive daily rows absent (not zero). Well was actually producing normally.
Row appears twice; naive summation double counts the day.
Gas meter flatlined at 0 while oil/water normal; GOR = 0 is non-physical.
Separator oil meter reads about 3.6 percentage points higher relative to summed well allocation from 2026-04-20 (meter factor change not applied to allocation).
WHP recorded as 9999 (instrument fault code) rather than blank; would corrupt averages and trend plots.
Status says SHUT-IN but 24 h of production reported; status flag stale.
